{{Top|leg}}
'''Cooling Stations''' were [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] located within [[Bantha Traxx]]. The club had three Cooling Stations, with the most popular being [[Oasis (Bantha Traxx)|Oasis]] on the establishment's second floor. The Stations sold icy refreshments, including [[Tatooine Sunburn]]s, [[Desert Bloom]]s, [[Ardees/Legends|Jawa Juice]], and [[Bantha Bottle]]s.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
